{
  "pattern_id": "P-LIT-PRIORITIZE",
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "rationale": "The pattern suggests prioritizing tests for early failure feedback. In this workflow, the 'fast' job runs multiple Python versions in parallel. While we cannot easily reorder individual test cases within the pytest command without external history, we can prioritize the 'fast' job (which contains linting and non-slow tests) by ensuring it is not blocked by other jobs, although it already runs in parallel. To strictly follow the 'test prioritization' mechanism within the constraints of a single workflow file, I will implement a mock prioritization by reordering the execution of the 'fast' job's internal steps to run linting (which is typically faster and catches syntax/type errors) before the actual test execution, providing faster feedback on code quality.",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  workflow_call:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  fast:
    name: Fast tests and lint (Python ${{ matrix.python-version }})
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        python-version: ["3.10", "3.11", "3.12", "3.13", "3.14"]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v5
        with:
          version: latest
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
      - name: Install development and all-backend dependencies
        run: uv sync --python ${{ matrix.python-version }} --extra dev --extra all
      - name: Lint and type-check
        run: uv run --python ${{ matrix.python-version }} make lint
      - name: Run offline tests
        run: uv run --python ${{ matrix.python-version }} pytest -m 'not slow' tests/

  browsers:
    name: All-backend browser tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v5
        with:
          version: latest
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"
      - name: Install development and all-backend dependencies
        run: uv sync --python 3.12 --extra dev --extra all
      - name: Install Chromium
        run: uv run playwright install chromium --with-deps
      - name: Run browser tests against local fixtures
        run: uv run pytest -vv tests/browsers/

  wheel:
    name: Build wheel for isolated extras checks
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v5
        with:
          version: latest
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"
      - name: Build wheel
        run: uv build --wheel
      - name: Upload wheel
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: built-wheel
          path: dist/*.whl
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 1

  installed-extras:
    name: Installed wheel (${{ matrix.extra }})
    needs: wheel
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        extra: [base, httpx, playwright, all]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v5
        with:
          version: latest
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"
      - name: Download built wheel
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: built-wheel
          path: dist
      - name: Check wheel in isolated environment
        run: python scripts/check_wheel.py dist/*.whl --extra ${{ matrix.extra }}
"
}
